name: Addon Vryno for Gravity Form
author: Vryno

sections.description:
Integrates Gravity Forms with vryno allowing form submissions to be automatically sent to your vryno account

Requires Gravity Forms.

External Dependencies

https://ms.vryno.dev/api/graphql/accounts: This domain is used to fetch account information for certain features within the plugin.
https://accounts.vryno.com/oidc/token: This domain is used to fetch account token
https:// . $instanceId . .ms.vryno.dev/api/graphql/crm: This domain is dynamically generated based on the $instanceId variable and is used to access CRM data.

Privacy notices

With the default configuration, this plugin, in itself, does not:

  • track users;
sections.installation:
Just install and activate plugin.

1, 2, 3: You’re done!
sections.faq:
1 Is its paid?

Till now not.
